## What's new

- Book titles on Home and Bookshelf now show the author underneath, using metadata from local EPUB files and the WeRead shelf. Books without author information, including local PDFs, show 「未知」. Continue Reading shows the source on the cover.
- Settings can display WeRead avatars served from WeRead's own avatar CDN.
- Tabs use the same fixed top inset, and an unchanged WeRead sync no longer moves the bookshelf.
- The bookshelf folder dialog keeps long names on one line and can grow to 75% of the available screen height before its contents scroll. The three-column layout and cover sizes are unchanged.
